Owner-led story

Meet Angel & Fatima

This is a family business in the truest sense. When you call Juncal's Flooring, you reach Angel and Fatima — the owners — who look at your floors, talk through what they actually need, and stand behind the work in your home.

From worn pre-war hardwood that deserves a second life to a full new install for a growing family, the approach is the same: honest advice first. If a floor can be restored for less than replacing it, they'll tell you. If it can't, they'll tell you that too.

Ask about this first
Restoration

Before & after: what sanding and refinishing can save

Many Queens hardwood floors don't need replacing — they need the old finish taken off and the real wood brought back. This is the kind of transformation to ask about on your call.

Representative photo
Before

Dull, scratched, traffic-worn finish. The wood underneath is often still sound — that's what Angel checks first.

After

Sanded back to bare wood, sealed, and finished to a clean sheen — without the cost or waste of a full tear-out.

Finish Studio

Tap a finish to re-grade the room photo live. Your pick is saved into your quote summary.

Natural Oak

Warm and true to the wood. Brightens a room without hiding the grain — the most forgiving choice for busy family floors.

Preview is a tone guide only — real samples look different in your light. Ask Angel to see samples in your home.

How it works

From first call to final coat

1

Call & describe it

Tell Angel what's going on — new floor, tired floor, or damage. Photos by text help.

2

In-home look

3

The work

Walk it together

A final walk-through so you see the finish, edges, and transitions before it's called done.
